title: command
description: A queued device command (a row of onyxchan_commands as delivered to a device). Delivered in the commands array of the /v1/checkin response, or inside an open session as a JSON-RPC tools/call (name = command name, arguments = args) in the mcp envelope. id is the idempotency key: devices dedupe by id. Lease = 2 x checkin_interval_s + 15 s (60 s minimum) for a command delivered by check-in, 60 s for a command sent into an open session; then re-queue; 3 attempts then failed; expires_at defaults to at least 3 x the device's checkin_interval_s (it must be longer than the maximum lease of 2 x checkin_interval_s + 15 s). A device that receives an id it already executed re-acks it (duplicate: true) and does not run it again.

attempts.description: Delivery attempts so far (incremented on each claim). At 3 failed leases the command becomes failed.

command_status.description: queued -> claimed (lease: 2 x checkin_interval_s + 15 s, 60 s minimum, by check-in; 60 s in a session) -> acked | (lease lapses -> queued, attempts+1) | failed (3 attempts or ack ok=false) | expired (expires_at passed before ack).

command_name.description: Device command vocabulary from PLAN v2.1 Phase 1.1 (+ play_tone for the Phase 5 success / wrong-item tones). 'inventory-display' is the legacy name of item-card: the gateway/onyx-mcp normalises it to item-card, devices never receive it.

args_face.description: Avatar expression. Values from set_expression in onyxchanTools.ts, minus 'vendor-display' (a command only; Chief decision 6).

args_move.description: Head pan/tilt, ranges from move_head in onyxchanTools.ts.

args_speak.description: Text to speak, synthesised by the gateway (Gemini voice); needs an open session. Sent to a sleeping device it is queued and runs on wake only if not expired, otherwise the caller gets expired. Spanish and English only.

args_item_card.description: Item card. Fields from display_inventory_card in onyxchanTools.ts. price is the retail price in USD (book_retail) and is present only when the target device's role allows it (staff-device); onyx-mcp strips it for voice devices. price_mxn and every other cost column are never allowed.

args_vendor_display.description: Vendor card. Fields from display_vendor_card in onyxchanTools.ts.

args_payment_card.description: Payment card: shown on screen for staff, never spoken, never passed to the voice model. Only a staff JWT with a finance role may enqueue it (Ramses to confirm: visitors may see the StackChan screen). Field set is an open question (no tool defines it yet).

args_gif.description: Accepted in the vocabulary so it is never silently dropped. v1 devices answer with an ack ok=false, error.code=unsupported (PLAN Phase 3.5). Field set is an open question.

args_play_tone.description: Feedback tone (Phase 5.4 success / wrong-item tones). Tone vocabulary is an open question.
